experiment.title: Exact gatewise TT compilation of first-norm source advice
experiment.objective: Construct exact TT cores for the five fixed trace-zero first-norm source tensors directly from the frozen RCB arithmetic circuit without B^5 enumeration, independently replay every toy value and exact bond rank, and measure complete preprocessing, retained advice, target specialization, traffic, and peak-state costs.

inputs.dependency_policy: source and target producers use the hash-bound Python 3.13.1 executable and installed NumPy 2.4.0 int64 closure; independent verifiers use Python arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic; data, source, runtime-package, and OS-loader reads remain separate

controls: rank-one separable exact addition and Hadamard products
asymmetric synthetic TT with exact ranks (1,2,3,4)
A plus negative A canonical-zero normalization
common-prefix independent-suffix direct sum requiring both normalization sweeps
general-basis XY source emitted but excluded from trace-zero retained advice
A plus negative A plus S cancellation with complete raw accounting
tagged zero followed by every supported TT operation
cumulative resource refusal without an individual object refusal
source-advice digest invariance under reversed target order
independent direct RCB enumeration in the verifier only
independent_variables: curve instance and registry size B
RCB addition stage and scalar gate

primary: producer full-tuple enumeration and prior-table read counts
independent source and target semantic mismatch counts
emitted TT bond dimensions versus independent exact unfolding ranks
per-gate raw and exact bond dimensions
maximum local factorization matrix and TT object words
fixed-curve preprocessing field operations and logical traffic
retained five-source advice words and canonical bytes
per-target coefficient, linear-combination, and recompression work
secondary: streamed Hadamard transfer dimensions and traffic
left-sweep and right-sweep factorization dimensions and traffic
two-stage contraction intermediate dimensions and traffic
allocation and free event trace with independently replayed peak liveness
complete C08 random gate transcript and local-operation replay
producer capability, file-read, transitive-source, dtype, range, and overflow audits
target-redacted source phase, frozen advice receipt, and separate target-specialization receipt
closed operation-IR trace versus transitive AST and call-graph audit
Python executable and installed NumPy closure attestation
diagnostic core words separated from retained advice
verifier-only B^5 tuple evaluations and RCB calls
peak resident memory and peak live field words
wall-clock time by cell, operation, and gate
special modulus, curve, generator, registry, and target structure
rho and prior B^5 comparator boundaries reported without an exponent claim

stopping_rules: Stop and preserve the first cell if any semantic or shape invariant fails.
Stop before allocating a local factorization matrix or TT object above 1000000 field words.
Stop before any predicted or observed process allocation can exceed 2 GiB RSS.
Stop and invalidate the producer partition if a B^5 tuple path or prior full tensor is reached.
Stop the source partition before any read of the inherited, target, mutation, verifier, or prior-artifact data path.
Stop before any array with more than three dimensions, forbidden dense kernel, unallowlisted file read, dynamic code event, child process, or network event.
Stop before any operation not representable by the closed IR or any source closure containing flattened B^5 traversal, five radix decodes, or an untraced allocation path.
Stop before any dot product whose actual canonical-value bound can reach signed int64 overflow.
Stop when any per-partition or whole-campaign cumulative operation, traffic, artifact, or CPU ceiling is reached, even if every individual object is small.
Stop and require a versioned protocol repair if an inherited manifest or RCB gate hash changes.
Do not stop merely because exact toy ranks saturate an ambient B or B^2 boundary.
invalidation_rules: Any curve, registry, target, mode order, tree, gate, sample, control, or mutation is selected after observing compiler ranks.
The producer enumerates five physical indices, reads a prior B^5 source table, or constructs cores from full tensor values.
The source compiler reads or infers any target-bearing or mutation-bearing record before the independently verified advice digest is frozen.
The producer uses an array above three dimensions, radix-decodes range(B**5), uses a forbidden NumPy index or contraction helper, or materializes a full raw Hadamard TT.
An allocation or arithmetic result lacks exactly one accepted IR producer, or the transitive AST/call-graph audit and runtime IR trace do not reconcile.
The generator and verifier import a common TT evaluator, RCB routine, rank routine, tuple iterator, target coefficient routine, or accounting calculator.
Any floating-point rank, SVD, tolerance, approximate rounding, or probabilistic sketch affects an emitted core.
Raw bond products are labeled exact ranks or discarded without accounting.
Factorization matrices, copies, transfers, direct sums, retained cores, failed gates, logical traffic, canonical bytes, or peak state are omitted.
Verifier exhaustive work is reclassified as preprocessing advice or online work.
A semantic match alone is called exact recompression without independent bond-rank equality.
A one-direction factorization sweep is reported as universally minimal exact recompression.

The Python executable, architecture, NumPy installed-package closure, loaded extension digest, dtype, C order, thread count, canonical input range, dot length, overflow bound, or immediate modular reduction differs from the frozen backend contract.
A work, traffic, liveness, or artifact counter resets at a gate or cell boundary.
Expected mutation detector labels are supplied to the verifier's semantic decision.
The trace-zero Z2 coefficient omits n*Y_Q^2 or the identity target is allowed to specialize to zero.
A first-norm compiler is described as a zero locator, relation algorithm, ECDLP break, or sub-rho result.
experiment.success_criterion: All six primary source cells and the modewise-rescaled source control compile from the target-redacted input; independent source verification freezes canonical advice before a separate process reads targets; all 25 target cells then complete with zero tuple-oracle paths, prior-table reads, capability violations, independent semantic mismatches, or exact-rank mismatches; the complete C08 gate transcript and all frozen controls replay; all 29 live-source or live-record mutations are independently rejected; operation IR, AST/call-graph, phase firewall, backend closure, componentwise operation, traffic, liveness, artifact, and verification ledgers reconcile without resets; and every per-object, per-partition, and whole-campaign gate passes.
experiment.falsification_criterion: A valid semantic mismatch rejects the affected circuit or TT operation; a valid bond mismatch rejects the exact-recompression claim; hidden enumeration or missing accounting invalidates the compiler evidence; and a resource stop weakens only the literal gatewise schedule at the first preserved gate and does not reject other exact TT or coefficient-space constructions.
experiment.approved_by: research-director after theory-review-v2, accounting-review-v2, and red-team-v4; source implementation only
